analogy.rationale: HIV integrase inhibitors are annotated to RELA, but the integrase enzyme is absent from human cells, so the transcriptional response is expected to be weak and largely off-target; other antivirals and HIV protease inhibitors share the antiviral context, while NFkB/IKK inhibitors overlap the RELA annotation.
